tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: All other documents as mentioned in Bid document

Should have provided Consultancy services in preparing the DPRs in Solid waste management or sanitation works or treatment system projects for at least One Assignments in last five years 2021-22 to 2025-26 in any State Government or Central Government departments or PSUs in preparing Detailed Project Reports for Solid waste management treatment system projects
The Consultancy firm shall be registered under The Companies Act 1956 or 2013 or The Societies Act 1860 or The Karnataka Societies Registration Act 1960/MSME Registered
The firm should have minimum annual financial turnover of 10.50 Lakhs equal to Amount put to tender in last 5 years 2021-22 to 2025-26
